short: Shell backing just recipes and hooks
is: Shell scripts backing the `just` dev-loop recipes and jj/session hooks — not cargo tests, but scripted proofs and glue for the manual dev loop.
conventions: `ZURFUR_*` env convention (env wins over `.env.example` defaults); each smoke script proves the dev loop itself at the shell/`just` level, distinct from the automated per-test-throwaway integration harness.
entry_points: ../Justfile (the pds-provision, pds-smoke, web-smoke, den-fill, workspace-init, nodes-install recipes call these)

fs.name: build-id.sh
fs.role: prints one line for ZURFUR_BUILD_ID: jj's working-copy parent commit (12 chars), else git HEAD, plus " (local changes)" when the working copy differs, else "unknown"; quiet, never fails, at most 64 bytes; the dev recipes export it when unset (tested by build-id.test.sh)

fs.name: ci-changes.sh
fs.role: the body of CI's changes job: verifies a PR's merge parents or a merge group's head and base, diffs, classifies with the base's ci-paths.sh (a merge group always runs everything); fails closed

fs.name: ci-paths.sh
fs.role: classifies changed paths as docs-only or code for CI's changes job and just gate-light; fails closed

fs.name: compose-logs.sh
fs.role: follows each compose service (db, plc, pds, caddy) from just before `just up` into logs/compose/<service>/: one setsid follower per service with a pidfile, the old one stopped first (only if its pid and start time still match), stopped by `just down` (tested by compose-logs.test.sh against a stub docker)

fs.name: den-fill.sh
fs.role: fills your Den on just dev with two commissions, one archived, as you, through the commission routes (one read-only SELECT for the skeleton tab id); the session cookie reaches curl only on stdin (just den-fill; tested by den-fill.test.sh and api/tests/den_postgres.rs)

fs.name: dev-log.sh
fs.role: the wrapper every dev recipe runs through: the terminal keeps its bytes, logs/<name>/<UTC stamp>.log gets them as plain text (a pipe through tee and a SIGINT-proof stripper, never script(1)), logs/latest/<name>.log links the newest, 10 kept, 0600 (tested by dev-log.test.sh)

fs.name: gate-light.sh
fs.role: the light local gate for restacks and fix rounds (just gate-light)

fs.name: hooks/
fs.role: the SessionStart/PreToolUse hook scripts wired in .claude/settings.json, and their tests

fs.name: jj-push.sh
fs.role: pre-push gate for jj — fmt + lint before code leaves the machine

fs.name: log-files.sh
fs.role: sourced by dev-log.sh, compose-logs.sh and logs.sh: the logs/ root (ZURFUR_LOG_DIR overrides), marked with .zurfur-logs only when missing or empty (a populated unmarked root is refused and left untouched), a fresh stamped file per run, the latest link (mv -fT) and the keep-10 retention

fs.name: logs.sh
fs.role: behind `just logs-tail [name]` (tail -F the latest files; an unknown name lists the names) and `just logs-clean` (stops the followers, removes logs/, only a root carrying the .zurfur-logs marker) (tested by logs.test.sh)

fs.name: nodes-fmt-hook.sh
fs.role: PostToolUse hook — nodes fmt on any NODE.json a model writes; fails soft without the binary

fs.name: nodes-install.sh
fs.role: download the pinned nodes release binary (checksum-verified) into ~/.cargo/bin; cargo-install fallback

fs.name: pds-provision.sh
fs.role: create/sign into the fixture test account on the local dev PDS, print session JSON

fs.name: pds-smoke-test.sh
fs.role: shell-level scripted proof the local PDS+PLC dev loop boots and is repeatable

fs.name: pr-wait.sh
fs.role: waits once for a PR's CI and Copilot review, then prints a short verdict

fs.name: tools-check.sh
fs.role: local tool versions vs CI's pins (warns) and SHA-pinned workflow actions (fails); just tools-check

fs.name: web-smoke.sh
fs.role: shell-level scripted proof the one-origin Caddy routing split works

fs.name: workspace-init.sh
fs.role: gives a secondary jj workspace (or a git worktree) its own dev-loop ports, DB and compose project through a managed .env block; refuses the primary checkout (just workspace-init; tested by workspace-init.test.sh)

notes: jj-push.sh (the `jj push` alias) runs as a hook, not just a recipe; the Claude Code hooks live in hooks/.
